## 11.7 PROPERTY-BASED TESTS (QuickCheck)

### 11.7.1 Ring Buffer Properties (tests/property_based/test_ring_buffer.rs)

```rust
// tests/property_based/test_ring_buffer.rs

use quickcheck::{quickcheck, TestResult, Arbitrary, Gen};
use buildtovalue::kernel::evidence::{TechnicalEvidence, Finding};
use buildtovalue::kernel::validators::{ValidatorModule, TechnicalSeverity};

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct ArbitraryFinding(Finding);

impl Arbitrary for ArbitraryFinding {
    fn arbitrary(g: &mut Gen) -> Self {
        let modules = [
            ValidatorModule::CPF,
            ValidatorModule::CNPJ,
            ValidatorModule::CreditCard,
            ValidatorModule::Entropy,
            ValidatorModule::ZScore,
        ];
        
        let severities = [
            TechnicalSeverity::Low,
            TechnicalSeverity::Medium,
            TechnicalSeverity::High,
            TechnicalSeverity::PolicyViolation,
            TechnicalSeverity::Critical,
        ];
        
        let module = *g.choose(&modules).unwrap();
        let severity = *g.choose(&severities).unwrap();
        
        let finding = Finding::new(
            module,
            severity,
            "ARBITRARY_FINDING",
            "Generated by QuickCheck",
            "Random finding for property testing",
        );
        
        ArbitraryFinding(finding)
    }
}

quickcheck! {
    /// Property: Ring buffer nunca excede capacidade
    fn prop_ring_buffer_never_overflows(findings: Vec<ArbitraryFinding>) -> bool {
        let mut evidence = TechnicalEvidence::new(0x1234);
        
        for ArbitraryFinding(finding) in findings {
            evidence.add_finding(finding);
        }
        
        // Invariante: finding_count <= 10 AND critical_count <= 3
        evidence.finding_count <= 10 && evidence.critical_count <= 3
    }
    
    /// Property: Critical findings nunca são sobrescritos
    fn prop_critical_findings_preserved(
        normal_findings: Vec<ArbitraryFinding>,
        critical_count: u8
    ) -> TestResult {
        if critical_count > 3 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let mut evidence = TechnicalEvidence::new(0x1234);
        
        // Adiciona critical findings
        for _ in 0..critical_count {
            evidence.add_finding(Finding::new(
                ValidatorModule::CPF,
                TechnicalSeverity::Critical,
                "CRITICAL_TEST",
                "Critical",
                "...",
            ));
        }
        
        let initial_critical_count = evidence.critical_count;
        
        // Adiciona findings normais (tentativa de overflow)
        for ArbitraryFinding(finding) in normal_findings {
            if !finding.severity.is_critical() {
                evidence.add_finding(finding);
            }
        }
        
        // Critical count não deve mudar (preservado)
        TestResult::from_bool(evidence.critical_count == initial_critical_count)
    }
    
    /// Property: Ordem FIFO no ring buffer
    fn prop_ring_buffer_fifo_order(count: u8) -> TestResult {
        if count == 0 || count > 20 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let mut evidence = TechnicalEvidence::new(0x1234);
        
        // Adiciona findings numerados
        for i in 0..count {
            evidence.add_finding(Finding::new(
                ValidatorModule::Entropy,
                TechnicalSeverity::Low,
                &format!("FINDING_{:02}", i),
                "Test",
                "...",
            ));
        }
        
        // Se count > 10, apenas últimos 10 devem estar presentes
        if count > 10 {
            let findings = evidence.get_all_findings();
            let titles: Vec<String> = findings.iter()
                .map(|f| {
                    std::str::from_utf8(&f.title)
                        .unwrap()
                        .trim_end_matches('\0')
                        .to_string()
                })
                .collect();
            
            // Primeiros (count - 10) devem ter sido sobrescritos
            let first_expected = format!("FINDING_{:02}", count - 10);
            let last_expected = format!("FINDING_{:02}", count - 1);
            
            TestResult::from_bool(
                titles.contains(&last_expected) && 
                !titles.contains(&"FINDING_00".to_string())
            )
        } else {
            // Todos devem estar presentes
            TestResult::from_bool(evidence.finding_count == count)
        }
    }
}
```

### 11.7.2 Hash Integrity Properties (tests/property_based/test_hash_integrity.rs)

```rust
// tests/property_based/test_hash_integrity.rs

use quickcheck::{quickcheck, TestResult};
use buildtovalue::kernel::evidence::TechnicalEvidence;

quickcheck! {
    /// Property: Hashes idênticos para inputs idênticos (determinismo)
    fn prop_hash_deterministic(audit_trail_id: u64, finding_count: u8) -> TestResult {
        if finding_count > 10 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let mut evidence1 = TechnicalEvidence::new(audit_trail_id);
        let mut evidence2 = TechnicalEvidence::new(audit_trail_id);
        
        // Adiciona mesmos findings
        for i in 0..finding_count {
            let finding = create_test_finding(i);
            evidence1.add_finding(finding.clone());
            evidence2.add_finding(finding);
        }
        
        evidence1.finalize().unwrap();
        evidence2.finalize().unwrap();
        
        TestResult::from_bool(
            evidence1.evidence_hash == evidence2.evidence_hash &&
            evidence1.checksum == evidence2.checksum
        )
    }
    
    /// Property: Hashes diferentes para inputs diferentes
    fn prop_hash_collision_resistance(
        audit_trail_id1: u64,
        audit_trail_id2: u64
    ) -> TestResult {
        if audit_trail_id1 == audit_trail_id2 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let mut evidence1 = TechnicalEvidence::new(audit_trail_id1);
        let mut evidence2 = TechnicalEvidence::new(audit_trail_id2);
        
        evidence1.finalize().unwrap();
        evidence2.finalize().unwrap();
        
        // Hashes devem ser diferentes (alta probabilidade)
        TestResult::from_bool(evidence1.evidence_hash != evidence2.evidence_hash)
    }
    
    /// Property: Validação detecta tampering
    fn prop_validation_detects_tampering(
        audit_trail_id: u64,
        tampered_risk: u8
    ) -> TestResult {
        let mut evidence = TechnicalEvidence::new(audit_trail_id);
        
        evidence.add_finding(create_test_finding(0));
        evidence.finalize().unwrap();
        
        // Valida antes de tampering
        assert!(evidence.validate());
        
        // Tampering
        let original_risk = evidence.composite_risk;
        evidence.composite_risk = tampered_risk;
        
        if tampered_risk == original_risk {
            return TestResult::discard(); // Não é tampering
        }
        
        // Validação deve falhar
        TestResult::from_bool(!evidence.validate())
    }
    
    /// Property: Checksum único para cada estado
    fn prop_checksum_uniqueness(finding_count1: u8, finding_count2: u8) -> TestResult {
        if finding_count1 > 10 || finding_count2 > 10 || finding_count1 == finding_count2 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let mut evidence1 = TechnicalEvidence::new(0x1234);
        let mut evidence2 = TechnicalEvidence::new(0x1234);
        
        for i in 0..finding_count1 {
            evidence1.add_finding(create_test_finding(i));
        }
        
        for i in 0..finding_count2 {
            evidence2.add_finding(create_test_finding(i));
        }
        
        evidence1.finalize().unwrap();
        evidence2.finalize().unwrap();
        
        // Checksums devem ser diferentes
        TestResult::from_bool(evidence1.checksum != evidence2.checksum)
    }
}

// Helper
fn create_test_finding(index: u8) -> Finding {
    Finding::new(
        ValidatorModule::CPF,
        TechnicalSeverity::PolicyViolation,
        &format!("TEST_{}", index),
        "Test finding",
        "...",
    )
}
```

### 11.7.3 Ledger Chain Properties (tests/property_based/test_ledger_chain.rs)

```rust
// tests/property_based/test_ledger_chain.rs

use quickcheck::{quickcheck, TestResult};
use buildtovalue::kernel::ledger::*;

quickcheck! {
    /// Property: Chain de hashes é transitiva
    fn prop_chain_transitivity(entry_count: u8) -> TestResult {
        if entry_count < 2 || entry_count > 50 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let entries = create_chain_of_entries(entry_count as usize);
        
        // Valida que cada entry aponta para anterior
        for i in 1..entries.len() {
            if !entries[i].validate_chain(&entries[i-1]) {
                return TestResult::failed();
            }
        }
        
        TestResult::passed()
    }
    
    /// Property: Quebra de chain é detectada
    fn prop_chain_break_detection(
        entry_count: u8,
        break_index: usize
    ) -> TestResult {
        if entry_count < 3 || entry_count > 20 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        if break_index >= entry_count as usize {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let mut entries = create_chain_of_entries(entry_count as usize);
        
        // Quebra chain (modifica hash anterior)
        entries[break_index].previous_entry_hash = 0xDEADBEEF;
        entries[break_index].finalize();
        
        // Validação do entry seguinte deve falhar
        if break_index < entries.len() - 1 {
            TestResult::from_bool(!entries[break_index + 1].validate_chain(&entries[break_index]))
        } else {
            TestResult::passed()
        }
    }
    
    /// Property: Merkle root é acumulativo
    fn prop_merkle_root_accumulative(entry_count: u8) -> TestResult {
        if entry_count < 2 || entry_count > 30 {
            return TestResult::discard();
        }
        
        let entries = create_chain_of_entries(entry_count as usize);
        
        // Merkle roots devem ser todos diferentes (acumulativos)
        let mut merkle_roots: Vec<u64> = entries.iter()
            .map(|e| e.merkle_root)
            .collect();
        
        merkle_roots.dedup();
        
        // Se todos são diferentes, dedup não muda tamanho
        TestResult::from_bool(merkle_roots.len() == entries.len())
    }
}
```

## 11.8 STRESS TESTS

### 11.8.1 Concurrent Access (tests/stress/test_concurrent.rs)

```rust
// tests/stress/test_concurrent.rs

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::thread;
use std::time::Duration;

#[test]
fn test_concurrent_evidence_creation() {
    let num_threads = 16;
    let iterations_per_thread = 1000;
    
    let mut handles = vec![];
    
    for thread_id in 0..num_threads {
        let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
            for i in 0..iterations_per_thread {
                let mut evidence = TechnicalEvidence::new((thread_id * 1000 + i) as u64);
                
                // Adiciona findings
                for j in 0..5 {
                    evidence.add_finding(create_test_finding(j));
                }
                
                // Finaliza
                evidence.finalize().unwrap();
                
                // Valida
                assert!(evidence.validate());
            }
        });
        
        handles.push(handle);
    }
    
    for handle in handles {
        handle.join().unwrap();
    }
    
    println!("\n✅ Concurrent evidence creation: {} threads × {} iterations", 
             num_threads, iterations_per_thread);
}

#[test]
fn test_concurrent_ledger_writes() {
    use buildtovalue::kernel::ledger::DurableLedger;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    
    let ledger = Arc::new(DurableLedger::new(
        PathBuf::from("/tmp/stress_test_ledger.dat")
    ).unwrap());
    
    let num_threads = 8;
    let writes_per_thread = 500;
    
    let mut handles = vec![];
    
    for thread_id in 0..num_threads {
        let ledger_clone = Arc::clone(&ledger);
        
        let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
            for i in 0..writes_per_thread {
                let evidence = TechnicalEvidence::new((thread_id * 1000 + i) as u64);
                let verdict = create_mock_verdict();
                let entry = LedgerEntry::new(
                    thread_id * 1000 + i,
                    evidence.audit_trail_id,
                    &evidence,
                    &verdict,
                    0,
                );
                
                ledger_clone.append(entry).unwrap();
            }
        });
        
        handles.push(handle);
    }
    
    for handle in handles {
        handle.join().unwrap();
    }
    
    println!("\n✅ Concurrent ledger writes: {} threads × {} writes", 
             num_threads, writes_per_thread);
}

#[test]
fn test_sustained_load() {
    let kernel = Arc::new(RustSovereignKernel::new());
    let duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
    
    println!("\n🔥 Sustained load test (30 seconds)...");
    
    let start = Instant::now();
    let request_count = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0));
    
    let mut handles = vec![];
    
    for _ in 0..8 {
        let kernel_clone = Arc::clone(&kernel);
        let count_clone = Arc::clone(&request_count);
        
        let handle = thread::spawn(move || {
            while start.elapsed() < duration {
                let input = "CPF: 123.456.789-09";
                let _ = kernel_clone.scan_for_evidence(input);
                
                count_clone.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        });
        
        handles.push(handle);
    }
    
    // Monitor progress
    for i in 0..30 {
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
        let current_count = request_count.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
        print!(".");
        std::io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
        
        if (i + 1) % 10 == 0 {
            println!(" {}s: {} req", i + 1, current_count);
        }
    }
    
    for handle in handles {
        handle.join().unwrap();
    }
    
    let total = request_count.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
    let throughput = total as f64 / 30.0;
    
    println!("\n✅ Sustained load completed:");
    println!("   Total requests: {}", total);
    println!("   Throughput: {:.0} req/s", throughput);
}
```


## PARTE 14: DEPLOYMENT GUIDE (DOCKER, KUBERNETES, CI/CD)

### 14.1 DOCKER SETUP

#### 14.1.1 Multi-Stage Dockerfile (Rust + Python)

```dockerfile
# Dockerfile

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1: Rust Builder (Sovereign Kernel)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

FROM rust:1.75-slim-bookworm AS rust-builder

# Instala dependências de build
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    pkg-config \
    libssl-dev \
    build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /build

# Cache de dependências (layer optimization)
COPY ../../rust/Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
COPY src/kernel/Cargo.toml src/kernel/
RUN mkdir -p src/kernel/src && \
    echo "fn main() {}" > src/kernel/src/main.rs && \
    cargo build --release --manifest-path src/kernel/Cargo.toml && \
    rm -rf src/kernel/src

# Build real
COPY src/kernel src/kernel/
RUN cargo build --release --manifest-path src/kernel/Cargo.toml

# Strip symbols (reduz tamanho em ~40%)
RUN strip target/release/buildtovalue_kernel

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2: Python Dependencies Builder
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

FROM python:3.11-slim-bookworm AS python-builder

# Instala Poetry
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir poetry==1.7.1

WORKDIR /build

# Cache de dependências Python
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock ./
RUN poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true && \
    poetry install --no-dev --no-root

# Copia código Python
COPY src/governance src/governance/
RUN poetry build -f wheel

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 3: Runtime Final (Minimal)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

FROM python:3.11-slim-bookworm

# Metadata
LABEL maintainer="daniel@buildtovalue.com"
LABEL version="2.0.0"
LABEL description="BuildToValue Trust OS - Ethical AI Governance"

# Cria usuário não-root
RUN groupadd -r buildtovalue && \
    useradd -r -g buildtovalue -u 1000 buildtovalue

# Instala apenas runtime essencial
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    ca-certificates \
    libssl3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Copia binário Rust
COPY --from=rust-builder /build/target/release/buildtovalue_kernel /app/bin/
COPY --from=rust-builder /build/target/release/libbuildtovalue_kernel.so /app/lib/

# Copia ambiente Python
COPY --from=python-builder /build/.venv /app/.venv
COPY --from=python-builder /build/dist/*.whl /tmp/

# Instala wheel
RUN /app/.venv/bin/pip install /tmp/*.whl && rm /tmp/*.whl

# Copia configs
COPY profiles /app/profiles
COPY config /app/config
COPY ../../scripts /app/scripts

# Permissões
RUN chown -R buildtovalue:buildtovalue /app && \
    chmod +x /app/bin/buildtovalue_kernel && \
    chmod +x /app/scripts/*.sh

# Cria diretórios de dados
RUN mkdir -p /app/data/ledger /app/data/explanations /app/logs && \
    chown -R buildtovalue:buildtovalue /app/data /app/logs

# Variáveis de ambiente
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app \
    PATH=/app/.venv/bin:/app/bin:$PATH \
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/app/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
    RUST_LOG=info \
    BUILDTOVALUE_ENV=production \
    BUILDTOVALUE_CONFIG=/app/config/production.yaml

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
    CMD /app/scripts/healthcheck.sh || exit 1

# Expõe portas
EXPOSE 8000 9090

# Muda para usuário não-root
USER buildtovalue

# Entrypoint
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/scripts/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["serve"]
```

#### 14.1.2 Docker Compose (Development)

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml

version: '3.9'

services:
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # BuildToValue Core Service
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  buildtovalue:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        BUILD_ENV: development
    image: buildtovalue:dev
    container_name: buildtovalue-core
    hostname: buildtovalue
    restart: unless-stopped
    
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"   # HTTP API

      - ./data/ledger:/app/data/ledger
      - ./data/explanations:/app/data/explanations
      
      # Logs

      # Hot-reload para dev (opcional)
      - ./src:/app/src:ro
      - ./profiles:/app/profiles:ro
      - ./config:/app/config:ro
    
    environment:
      - BUILDTOVALUE_ENV=development
      - RUST_LOG=debug
      - RUST_BACKTRACE=1
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://btv:password@postgres:5432/buildtovalue
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
      - SIGNING_KEY_PATH=/run/secrets/signing_key
      - ENABLE_SWAGGER=true
    
    secrets:
      - signing_key
    
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    
    networks:
      - buildtovalue-net
    
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/app/scripts/healthcheck.sh"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    
    # Resource limits (development)
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: '2.0'
          memory: 2G
        reservations:
          cpus: '0.5'
          memory: 512M
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # PostgreSQL (Metadata & Appeals)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: buildtovalue-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: buildtovalue
      POSTGRES_USER: btv
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF8 --locale=C"
    
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./scripts/init_db.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql:ro
    
    networks:
      - buildtovalue-net
    
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U btv -d buildtovalue"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Redis (Cache & Session)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: buildtovalue-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    
    networks:
      - buildtovalue-net
    
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
    
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Prometheus (Metrics)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.48.0
    container_name: buildtovalue-prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped

      - '--web.console.templates=/usr/share/prometheus/consoles'

      - prometheus-data:/prometheus
    
    networks:

  # Grafana (Dashboards)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:10.2.2
    container_name: buildtovalue-grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS=redis-datasource
    
    volumes:
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./config/grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards:ro
      - ./config/grafana/datasources.yml:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml:ro
    
    networks:
      - buildtovalue-net
    
    depends_on:
      - prometheus

volumes:
  postgres-data:
    driver: local
  redis-data:
    driver: local
  prometheus-data:
    driver: local
  grafana-data:
    driver: local

networks:
  buildtovalue-net:
    driver: bridge

secrets:
  signing_key:
    file: ./secrets/signing_key.txt
```

#### 14.1.3 Entrypoint Script

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# scripts/entrypoint.sh

set -e

echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "BuildToValue v2.0 - Trust OS for AI"
echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"

# Validações de ambiente
if [ -z "$BUILDTOVALUE_ENV" ]; then
    echo "❌ ERROR: BUILDTOVALUE_ENV not set"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Environment: $BUILDTOVALUE_ENV"

# Valida assinatura de policies
echo "🔍 Validating policy signatures..."
python /app/scripts/validate_policies.py || {
    echo "❌ Policy validation failed"
    exit 1
}

# Migra banco de dados (se necessário)
if [ "$BUILDTOVALUE_ENV" != "test" ]; then
    echo "🗄️  Running database migrations..."
    alembic upgrade head || {
        echo "❌ Database migration failed"
        exit 1
    }
fi

# Inicializa Rust Kernel
echo "🦀 Initializing Rust Sovereign Kernel..."
/app/bin/buildtovalue_kernel --check || {
    echo "❌ Rust Kernel initialization failed"
    exit 1
}

# Verifica BiasDeclaration atualizado
echo "⚖️  Checking BiasDeclaration freshness..."
python /app/scripts/check_bias_freshness.py --max-age-days 90 || {
    echo "⚠️  WARNING: BiasDeclaration older than 90 days (requires recalibration)"
}

echo "✅ Pre-flight checks passed"
echo ""

# Executa comando
case "$1" in
    serve)
        echo "🚀 Starting BuildToValue API Server..."
        exec uvicorn app.main:app \
            --host 0.0.0.0 \
            --port 8000 \
            --workers 4 \
            --log-level info \
            --access-log \
            --use-colors
        ;;
    
    worker)
        echo "🔧 Starting background worker..."
        exec python /app/scripts/worker.py
        ;;
    
    migrate)
        echo "🗄️  Running database migrations..."
        exec alembic upgrade head
        ;;
    
    test)
        echo "🧪 Running tests..."
        exec pytest tests/ -v
        ;;
    
    shell)
        echo "🐚 Starting interactive shell..."
        exec /bin/bash
        ;;
    
    *)
        echo "Unknown command: $1"
        echo "Available commands: serve, worker, migrate, test, shell"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
```

***

#### 14.1.4 Healthcheck Script

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# scripts/healthcheck.sh

set -e

# Timeout de 5 segundos
TIMEOUT=5

# 1. Verifica processo Rust Kernel
if ! pgrep -x buildtovalue_kernel > /dev/null; then
    echo "❌ Rust Kernel not running"
    exit 1
fi

# 2. Verifica HTTP endpoint
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
    --max-time $TIMEOUT \
    http://localhost:8000/health)

if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
    echo "❌ HTTP health check failed (status: $HTTP_STATUS)"
    exit 1
fi

# 3. Verifica Prometheus metrics endpoint
METRICS_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
    --max-time $TIMEOUT \
    http://localhost:9090/metrics)

if [ "$METRICS_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
    echo "❌ Metrics endpoint failed (status: $METRICS_STATUS)"
    exit 1
fi

# 4. Verifica latência (deve ser < 100ms)
LATENCY=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}" \
    --max-time $TIMEOUT \
    http://localhost:8000/health)

LATENCY_MS=$(echo "$LATENCY * 1000" | bc)

if (( $(echo "$LATENCY_MS > 100" | bc -l) )); then
    echo "⚠️  WARNING: High latency (${LATENCY_MS}ms)"
fi

echo "✅ Health check passed (latency: ${LATENCY_MS}ms)"
exit 0
```

```yaml
  CONSTANT_TIME_VALIDATION: "true"
  JITTER_PERCENT: "0.10"
  
  # Governance
  TRUST_DECAY_HALF_LIFE_HOURS: "720"  # 30 dias
  MERCY_THRESHOLD_LOW: "0.5"
  MERCY_THRESHOLD_HIGH: "0.8"
  
  # Ledger
  WAL_CAPACITY: "10000"
  FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECONDS: "60"
  
  # Observability
  METRICS_PORT: "9090"
  HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS: "30"

---

type: Opaque
stringData:

  REDIS_URL: "redis://redis-service:6379/0"
  SIGNING_KEY: "REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_KEY_32_BYTES_LONG_SECURE_KEY"
  SMTP_PASSWORD: "email_password_here"
```

#### 14.2.2 Deployment

```yaml
# k8s/10-deployment.yaml

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: buildtovalue
  namespace: buildtovalue
  labels:
    app: buildtovalue
    version: v2.0.0
spec:
  replicas: 3
  
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0  # Zero-downtime
  
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: buildtovalue
  
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: buildtovalue
        version: v2.0.0
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "9090"
        prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
    
    spec:
      # Security context
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      
      # Init container: Valida policies antes de iniciar
      initContainers:
        - name: validate-policies
          image: buildtovalue:2.0.0
          command: ["/app/scripts/validate_policies.py"]
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: buildtovalue-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: profiles
              mountPath: /app/profiles
              readOnly: true
      
      containers:
        - name: buildtovalue
          image: buildtovalue:2.0.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
              protocol: TCP
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 9090
              protocol: TCP
          
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: buildtovalue-config
          
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: buildtovalue-secrets
                  key: DATABASE_URL
            
            - name: REDIS_URL
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: buildtovalue-secrets
                  key: REDIS_URL
            
            - name: SIGNING_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: buildtovalue-secrets
                  key: SIGNING_KEY
            
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace
            
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
          
          # Resource requests/limits
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "2Gi"
          
          # Liveness probe (reinicia se unhealthy)
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          
          # Readiness probe (remove do load balancer se not ready)
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          
          # Startup probe (dá mais tempo para inicialização)
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30  # 150s total
          
          # Volumes
          volumeMounts:
            - name: ledger-storage
              mountPath: /app/data/ledger
            
            - name: explanations-storage
              mountPath: /app/data/explanations
            
            - name: profiles
              mountPath: /app/profiles
              readOnly: true
            
            - name: logs
              mountPath: /app/logs
          
          # Lifecycle hooks
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 15"]  # Drain connections
      
      # Volumes
      volumes:
        - name: ledger-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: buildtovalue-ledger-pvc
        
        - name: explanations-storage
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: buildtovalue-explanations-pvc
        
        - name: profiles
          configMap:
            name: buildtovalue-profiles
        
        - name: logs
          emptyDir: {}
      
      # Anti-affinity (distribui pods em nodes diferentes)
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchExpressions:
                    - key: app
                      operator: In
                      values:
                        - buildtovalue
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
```

#### 14.2.3 Service & Ingress

```yaml
# k8s/20-service.yaml

apiVersion: v1

# k8s/21-ingress.yaml

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: buildtovalue-ingress
  namespace: buildtovalue
  annotations:
    # NGINX Ingress
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/force-ssl-redirect: "true"
    
    # Rate limiting
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-connections: "10"
    
    # Timeouts
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "60"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "60"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "60"
    
    # Buffer sizes
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "1m"
    
    # CORS (se necessário)
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-cors: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-methods: "GET, POST, OPTIONS"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-credentials: "true"
    
    # Cert Manager (TLS automático)
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: "letsencrypt-prod"

spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - api.buildtovalue.com
      secretName: buildtovalue-tls
  
  rules:
    - host: api.buildtovalue.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: buildtovalue-service
                port:
                  number: 80
```

#### 14.2.5 HorizontalPodAutoscaler

```yaml
# k8s/40-hpa.yaml

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: buildtovalue-hpa
  namespace: buildtovalue
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: buildtovalue
  
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 10
  
  metrics:
    # CPU
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    
    # Memory
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
    
    # Custom metric: Request latency (p99)
    - type: Pods
      pods:
        metric:
          name: http_request_duration_p99
        target:
          type: AverageValue
          averageValue: "30m"  # 30ms
  
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300  # 5 min antes de scale down
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 50  # Reduz no máximo 50% dos pods de cada vez
          periodSeconds: 60
    
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0  # Scale up imediato
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 100  # Dobra número de pods se necessário
          periodSeconds: 15
        - type: Pods
          value: 2  # Adiciona no máximo 2 pods de cada vez
          periodSeconds: 15
      selectPolicy: Max
```

### 14.3 CI/CD PIPELINE (GITHUB ACTIONS)

#### 14.3.1 Build & Test Workflow

```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci.yml

name: CI - Build & Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 1: Rust Tests (Kernel)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  rust-tests:
    name: Rust Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      
      - name: Cache Cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/bin/
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
            target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
        working-directory: src/kernel
      
      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
        working-directory: src/kernel
      
      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release
        working-directory: src/kernel
      
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo test --release
        working-directory: src/kernel
      
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: cargo test --release --test '*' -- --test-threads=1
        working-directory: src/kernel
      
      - name: Run benchmarks (smoke test)
        run: cargo bench --no-run
        working-directory: src/kernel
      
      - name: Upload Rust artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: rust-binaries
          path: src/kernel/target/release/buildtovalue_kernel
          retention-days: 7
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 2: Python Tests (Governance)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  python-tests:
    name: Python Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'
      
      - name: Install Poetry
        run: pip install poetry==1.7.1
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: poetry install
        working-directory: src/governance
      
      - name: Run Black (formatter check)
        run: poetry run black --check .
        working-directory: src/governance
      
      - name: Run Flake8 (linter)
        run: poetry run flake8 .
        working-directory: src/governance
      
      - name: Run MyPy (type checker)
        run: poetry run mypy .
        working-directory: src/governance
      
      - name: Run Pytest
        run: poetry run pytest tests/ -v --cov=governance --cov-report=xml
        working-directory: src/governance
      
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          files: src/governance/coverage.xml
          flags: python
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 3: Adversarial Tests (Security)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  adversarial-tests:
    name: Adversarial Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [rust-tests, python-tests]
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install poetry
          poetry install
        working-directory: tests/adversarial
      
      - name: Run timing attack tests
        run: poetry run pytest test_timing_attacks.py -v
        working-directory: tests/adversarial
      
      - name: Run injection tests
        run: poetry run pytest test_injection.py -v
        working-directory: tests/adversarial
      
      - name: Run evasion tests
        run: poetry run pytest test_evasion.py -v
        working-directory: tests/adversarial
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 4: Ethical Tests (Philosophy)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ethical-tests:
    name: Ethical Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [rust-tests, python-tests]
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install poetry
          poetry install
        working-directory: tests/ethical
      
      - name: Run Rawls tests (Véu da Ignorância)
        run: poetry run pytest test_rawls.py -v
        working-directory: tests/ethical
      
      - name: Run Gilligan tests (Misericórdia)
        run: poetry run pytest test_gilligan.py -v
        working-directory: tests/ethical
      
      - name: Run Levinas tests (Cuidado)
        run: poetry run pytest test_levinas.py -v
        working-directory: tests/ethical
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 5: Policy Validation
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  policy-validation:
    name: Policy Validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: contains(github.event.head_commit.modified, 'profiles/')
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      
      - name: Validate YAML syntax
        run: python scripts/validate_policy_syntax.py profiles/*.yaml
      
      - name: Blind Policy Testing
        run: python scripts/blind_policy_test.py --policies profiles/*.yaml
      
      - name: Check BiasDeclaration
        run: python scripts/check_bias_declaration.py profiles/*.yaml
      
      - name: Request Ethical Committee Review
        if: success()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `🔍 **Policy Change Detected**\n\nEthical Committee review required.\n\n**Reviewers:** @ethical-committee-member-1 @ethical-committee-member-2\n**Approval Quorum:** 2/3`
            })
```

### 14.3.2 Deploy Workflow (GitHub Actions)

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml

name: CD - Deploy to Production

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'  # Triggers on version tags (e.g., v2.0.0)
  
  workflow_dispatch:  # Manual trigger
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Deployment environment'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 1: Pre-Deployment Validation
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  pre-deploy-validation:
    name: Pre-Deployment Validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.get-version.outputs.version }}
      deployment-env: ${{ steps.determine-env.outputs.env }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Get version from tag
        id: get-version
        run: |
          if [[ $GITHUB_REF == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}
          else
            VERSION="dev-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "📦 Version: $VERSION"
      
      - name: Determine environment
        id: determine-env
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            ENV="${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}"
          elif [[ $GITHUB_REF == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            ENV="production"
          else
            ENV="staging"
          fi
          echo "env=$ENV" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "🎯 Target Environment: $ENV"
      
      - name: Validate version format
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.get-version.outputs.version }}"
          if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] && [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^dev- ]]; then
            echo "❌ Invalid version format: $VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi
      
      - name: Check required secrets
        env:
          DOCKER_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          KUBECONFIG_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_BASE64 }}
          SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEY_PROD }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$DOCKER_USERNAME" || -z "$KUBECONFIG_BASE64" || -z "$SIGNING_KEY" ]]; then
            echo "❌ Missing required secrets"
            exit 1
          fi
      
      - name: Run full test suite
        run: |
          echo "🧪 Running full test suite..."
          make test-all
      
      - name: Security scan (Trivy)
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          scan-ref: '.'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
          exit-code: '1'
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 2: Build & Push Docker Image
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  build-and-push:
    name: Build & Push Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: pre-deploy-validation
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      
      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}},value=${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}},value=${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
            type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.deployment-env == 'production' }}
      
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            BUILD_VERSION=${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
            BUILD_DATE=${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}
            GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }}
      
      - name: Scan image with Trivy
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
      
      - name: Upload Trivy results to GitHub Security
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 3: Deploy to Staging (Smoke Test)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [pre-deploy-validation, build-and-push]
    if: needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.deployment-env == 'staging' || needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.deployment-env == 'production'
    
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.buildtovalue.com
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
        with:
          version: 'v1.28.0'
      
      - name: Configure kubectl
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_STAGING_BASE64 }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
          export KUBECONFIG=$(pwd)/kubeconfig
          kubectl config current-context
      
      - name: Deploy to Kubernetes (staging)
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          export KUBECONFIG=$(pwd)/kubeconfig
          
          # Update image tag
          kubectl set image deployment/buildtovalue \
            buildtovalue=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${VERSION} \
            -n buildtovalue-staging
          
          # Wait for rollout
          kubectl rollout status deployment/buildtovalue \
            -n buildtovalue-staging \
            --timeout=5m
      
      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          echo "🔥 Running smoke tests against staging..."
          
          # Wait for service to be ready
          sleep 30
          
          # Health check
          curl -f https://staging.buildtovalue.com/health || exit 1
          
          # Basic request test
          curl -X POST https://staging.buildtovalue.com/api/v2/validate \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"text": "Teste CPF: 123.456.789-09"}' \
            -f || exit 1
          
          echo "✅ Smoke tests passed"
      
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          echo "🧪 Running integration tests..."
          export TEST_BASE_URL=https://staging.buildtovalue.com
          poetry run pytest tests/integration/ -v
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 4: Deploy to Production (Blue-Green)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [pre-deploy-validation, build-and-push, deploy-staging]
    if: needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.deployment-env == 'production'
    
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://api.buildtovalue.com
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
        with:
          version: 'v1.28.0'
      
      - name: Configure kubectl
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBECONFIG_PROD_BASE64 }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
          export KUBECONFIG=$(pwd)/kubeconfig
          kubectl config current-context
      
      - name: Ethical Committee Approval Check
        run: |
          echo "⚖️ Checking Ethical Committee approval..."
          
          # Verifica se PR associado tem aprovação do Ethical Committee
          # (2/3 membros devem aprovar)
          APPROVALS=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} \
            --json reviews \
            --jq '[.reviews[] | select(.author.login | IN("ethical-committee-1", "ethical-committee-2", "ethical-committee-3")) | select(.state == "APPROVED")] | length')
          
          if [[ $APPROVALS -lt 2 ]]; then
            echo "❌ Insufficient Ethical Committee approvals ($APPROVALS/3)"
            echo "Required: 2/3 approvals"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Ethical Committee approval: $APPROVALS/3"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Create backup of current deployment
        run: |
          export KUBECONFIG=$(pwd)/kubeconfig
          
          echo "💾 Creating backup..."
          kubectl get deployment buildtovalue -n buildtovalue -o yaml > backup-deployment.yaml
          
          # Upload backup
          aws s3 cp backup-deployment.yaml \
            s3://buildtovalue-backups/deployments/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-backup.yaml
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      
      - name: Deploy to Production (Blue-Green)
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          export KUBECONFIG=$(pwd)/kubeconfig
          
          echo "🚀 Deploying version ${VERSION} to production..."
          
          # 1. Deploy green version (novo)
          kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
          apiVersion: apps/v1
          kind: Deployment
          metadata:
            name: buildtovalue-green
            namespace: buildtovalue
          spec:
            replicas: 3
            selector:
              matchLabels:
                app: buildtovalue
                version: green
            template:
              metadata:
                labels:
                  app: buildtovalue
                  version: green
              spec:
                containers:
                - name: buildtovalue
                  image: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${VERSION}
                  # ... (rest of pod spec)
          EOF
          
          # 2. Wait for green to be ready
          kubectl rollout status deployment/buildtovalue-green -n buildtovalue --timeout=5m
          
          # 3. Run health checks
          GREEN_POD=$(kubectl get pod -n buildtovalue -l version=green -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
          kubectl exec -n buildtovalue $GREEN_POD -- /app/scripts/healthcheck.sh
          
          # 4. Switch traffic to green (update service selector)
          kubectl patch service buildtovalue-service -n buildtovalue -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"green"}}}'
          
          echo "✅ Traffic switched to green version"
          
          # 5. Monitor for 5 minutes
          echo "📊 Monitoring for 5 minutes..."
          sleep 300
          
          # 6. Check error rate
          ERROR_RATE=$(curl -s "http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(http_requests_total{status=~'5..'}[5m])" | jq -r '.data.result[0].value [ppl-ai-file-upload.s3.amazonaws](https://ppl-ai-file-upload.s3.amazonaws.com/web/direct-files/collection_ef4ea732-1eb6-44b5-a233-e0f25f3b7410/a8bf2d44-ead0-43f2-99b4-cf572fdbfb91/paste.txt)')
          
          if (( $(echo "$ERROR_RATE > 0.01" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "❌ High error rate detected: $ERROR_RATE"
            echo "Rolling back..."
            kubectl patch service buildtovalue-service -n buildtovalue -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"blue"}}}'
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # 7. Scale down blue (old)
          kubectl scale deployment/buildtovalue-blue -n buildtovalue --replicas=0
          
          # 8. Rename green to blue (for next deployment)
          kubectl delete deployment buildtovalue-blue -n buildtovalue || true
          kubectl get deployment buildtovalue-green -n buildtovalue -o yaml | \
            sed 's/buildtovalue-green/buildtovalue-blue/g' | \
            sed 's/version: green/version: blue/g' | \
            kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl delete deployment buildtovalue-green -n buildtovalue
          
          echo "✅ Blue-Green deployment completed"
      
      - name: Update Ledger with deployment record
        run: |
          echo "📝 Recording deployment in ledger..."
          
          curl -X POST https://api.buildtovalue.com/internal/deployment-record \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.INTERNAL_API_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
              "version": "${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}",
              "timestamp": "'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)'",
              "deployer": "${{ github.actor }}",
              "commit": "${{ github.sha }}",
              "environment": "production",
              "ethical_committee_approvals": 2
            }'
      
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          text: |
            🚀 **Production Deployment Successful**
            
            Version: ${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
            Deployer: ${{ github.actor }}
            Commit: ${{ github.sha }}
            
            🔗 https://api.buildtovalue.com
          webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
        if: success()
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # JOB 5: Post-Deployment Verification
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  post-deploy-verification:
    name: Post-Deployment Verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-production
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          echo "🧪 Running E2E tests against production..."
          export TEST_BASE_URL=https://api.buildtovalue.com
          export TEST_API_KEY=${{ secrets.TEST_API_KEY_PROD }}
          
          poetry run pytest tests/e2e/ -v --maxfail=1
      
      - name: Performance benchmark
        run: |
          echo "⚡ Running performance benchmarks..."
          
          # Latency test (p99 deve ser < 50ms)
          for i in {1..1000}; do
            curl -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null -s \
              https://api.buildtovalue.com/api/v2/validate \
              -X POST \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d '{"text": "Test"}'
          done > latencies.txt
          
          P99=$(sort -n latencies.txt | tail -1)
          echo "P99 Latency: ${P99}s"
          
          if (( $(echo "$P99 > 0.050" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "❌ P99 latency exceeds 50ms"
            exit 1
          fi
      
      - name: Monitor error rate (24h)
        run: |
          echo "📊 Monitoring will continue for 24h..."
          echo "Alert channels: Slack, PagerDuty, Email"
          
          # Configura alertas
          curl -X POST https://api.buildtovalue.com/internal/monitoring/alerts \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.INTERNAL_API_TOKEN }}" \
            -d '{
              "deployment_version": "${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}",
              "monitoring_duration_hours": 24,
              "alert_thresholds": {
                "error_rate_percent": 1.0,
                "p99_latency_ms": 50,
                "availability_percent": 99.9
              }
            }'
      
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
          release_name: BuildToValue v${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
          body: |
            ## 🚀 Release v${{ needs.pre-deploy-validation.outputs.version }}
            
            ### ✨ Highlights
            - Deployed to production on $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
            - Ethical Committee approval: ✅ 2/3
            - All tests passing: ✅
            
            ### 📊 Metrics
            - P99 Latency: < 50ms
            - Availability: 99.9%+
            - Test Coverage: 85%+
            
            ### 🔗 Links
            - [API Docs](https://api.buildtovalue.com/docs)
            - [Grafana Dashboard](https://grafana.buildtovalue.com)
            - [Status Page](https://status.buildtovalue.com)
            
            ### 🛡️ Security
            - Trivy scan: ✅ No critical vulnerabilities
            - BiasDeclaration: ✅ Updated < 90 days
            - Signing key: ✅ Rotated
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```

### 14.5 DEPLOYMENT SCRIPTS

#### 14.5.1 One-Click Deploy Script

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# scripts/deploy.sh

set -euo pipefail

# Colors
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENVIRONMENTS=("staging" "production")
REQUIRED_APPROVALS=2

function print_banner() {
    echo ""
    echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
    echo "  BuildToValue v2.0 - Deployment Script"
    echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
    echo ""
}

function log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

function log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

function log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

function check_prerequisites() {
    log_info "Checking prerequisites..."
    
    # Check tools
    local tools=("kubectl" "docker" "helm" "jq" "curl")
    for tool in "${tools[@]}"; do
        if ! command -v "$tool" &> /dev/null; then
            log_error "$tool not found. Please install it."
            exit 1
        fi
    done
    
    # Check kubectl context
    CURRENT_CONTEXT=$(kubectl config current-context)
    log_info "Current kubectl context: $CURRENT_CONTEXT"
    
    # Check GitHub CLI (for approval check)
    if ! command -v gh &> /dev/null; then
        log_warn "GitHub CLI not found. Skipping approval check."
        SKIP_APPROVAL_CHECK=true
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ Prerequisites OK"
}

function select_environment() {
    echo ""
    echo "Select deployment environment:"
    echo "  1) staging"
    echo "  2) production"
    echo ""
    read -p "Enter choice [1-2]: " choice
    
    case $choice in
        1) ENVIRONMENT="staging" ;;
        2) ENVIRONMENT="production" ;;
        *) log_error "Invalid choice"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    
    log_info "Selected environment: $ENVIRONMENT"
}

function check_ethical_approval() {
    if [[ "$ENVIRONMENT" != "production" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    
    if [[ "${SKIP_APPROVAL_CHECK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
        log_warn "Skipping approval check (GitHub CLI not available)"
        read -p "Do you have Ethical Committee approval? (yes/no): " approval
        if [[ "$approval" != "yes" ]]; then
            log_error "Ethical Committee approval required for production"
            exit 1
        fi
        return 0
    fi
    
    log_info "Checking Ethical Committee approvals..."
    
    # Get current branch/PR
    CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
    PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number -q .number 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    
    if [[ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]]; then
        log_error "No PR found for branch $CURRENT_BRANCH"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Count approvals from Ethical Committee members
    APPROVALS=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" \
        --json reviews \
        --jq '[.reviews[] | select(.author.login | IN("ethical-committee-1", "ethical-committee-2", "ethical-committee-3")) | select(.state == "APPROVED")] | length')
    
    log_info "Ethical Committee approvals: $APPROVALS/$REQUIRED_APPROVALS"
    
    if [[ "$APPROVALS" -lt "$REQUIRED_APPROVALS" ]]; then
        log_error "Insufficient approvals. Required: $REQUIRED_APPROVALS"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ Ethical Committee approval OK"
}

function run_tests() {
    log_info "Running test suite..."
    
    # Run tests in Docker (isolated)
    docker run --rm \
        -v "$(pwd)":/app \
        -w /app \
        buildtovalue:test \
        /bin/bash -c "make test-all"
    
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        log_error "Tests failed"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ All tests passed"
}

function build_image() {
    log_info "Building Docker image..."
    
    VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always)
    IMAGE_TAG="buildtovalue:$VERSION"
    
    docker build \
        --build-arg BUILD_VERSION="$VERSION" \
        --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
        --build-arg GIT_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
        -t "$IMAGE_TAG" \
        .
    
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        log_error "Docker build failed"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ Image built: $IMAGE_TAG"
    
    # Tag for registry
    docker tag "$IMAGE_TAG" "ghcr.io/buildtovalue/buildtovalue:$VERSION"
    
    export IMAGE_TAG
}

function push_image() {
    log_info "Pushing image to registry..."
    
    docker push "ghcr.io/buildtovalue/buildtovalue:$IMAGE_TAG"
    
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        log_error "Docker push failed"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ Image pushed"
}

function deploy_to_k8s() {
    log_info "Deploying to Kubernetes ($ENVIRONMENT)..."
    
    # Switch to correct namespace
    kubectl config set-context --current --namespace="buildtovalue-$ENVIRONMENT"
    
    # Update image tag
    kubectl set image deployment/buildtovalue \
        buildtovalue="ghcr.io/buildtovalue/buildtovalue:$IMAGE_TAG" \
        -n "buildtovalue-$ENVIRONMENT"
    
    # Wait for rollout
    log_info "Waiting for rollout..."
    kubectl rollout status deployment/buildtovalue \
        -n "buildtovalue-$ENVIRONMENT" \
        --timeout=10m
    
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        log_error "Rollout failed"
        log_warn "Rolling back..."
        kubectl rollout undo deployment/buildtovalue -n "buildtovalue-$ENVIRONMENT"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ Deployment successful"
}

function run_smoke_tests() {
    log_info "Running smoke tests..."
    
    if [[ "$ENVIRONMENT" == "staging" ]]; then
        BASE_URL="https://staging.buildtovalue.com"
    else
        BASE_URL="https://api.buildtovalue.com"
    fi
    
    # Health check
    HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$BASE_URL/health")
    if [[ "$HTTP_CODE" != "200" ]]; then
        log_error "Health check failed (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Basic validation
    RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v2/validate" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{"text": "Test CPF: 123.456.789-09"}')
    
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        log_error "Validation endpoint failed"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    log_info "✅ Smoke tests passed"
}

function create_deployment_record() {
    log_info "Creating deployment record..."
    
    cat > "deployment-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).json" <<EOF
{
  "version": "$IMAGE_TAG",
  "environment": "$ENVIRONMENT",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "deployer": "$(whoami)",
  "git_commit": "$(git rev-parse HEAD)",
  "git_branch": "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)",
  "ethical_approvals": $APPROVALS
}
EOF
    
    log_info "✅ Deployment record created"
}

function main() {
    print_banner
    
    check_prerequisites
    select_environment
    check_ethical_approval
    
    echo ""
    read -p "Continue with deployment? (yes/no): " confirm
    if [[ "$confirm" != "yes" ]]; then
        log_warn "Deployment cancelled"
        exit 0
    fi
    
    run_tests
    build_image
    push_image
    deploy_to_k8s
    run_smoke_tests
    create_deployment_record
    
    echo ""
    log_info "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
    log_info "🚀 Deployment completed successfully!"
    log_info "Environment: $ENVIRONMENT"
    log_info "Version: $IMAGE_TAG"
    log_info "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
}

main "$@"
```

## PARTE 16: MONITORING & OBSERVABILITY

### 16.1 PROMETHEUS CONFIGURATION

#### 16.1.1 Prometheus Config (config/prometheus.yml)

```yaml
# config/prometheus.yml

global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  external_labels:
    cluster: 'buildtovalue-prod'
    environment: 'production'

# Alertmanager configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
            - alertmanager:9093

# Load rules once and periodically evaluate them
rule_files:
  - '/etc/prometheus/rules/*.yml'

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # BuildToValue Core Service
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  - job_name: 'buildtovalue'
    
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
        namespaces:
          names:
            - buildtovalue
    
    relabel_configs:
      # Only scrape pods with prometheus.io/scrape annotation
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
        action: keep
        regex: true
      
      # Read metrics port from annotation
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
        action: replace
        target_label: __address__
        regex: ([^:]+)(?::\d+)?;(\d+)
        replacement: $1:$2
      
      # Read metrics path from annotation
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_path]
        action: replace
        target_label: __metrics_path__
        regex: (.+)
      
      # Add pod metadata as labels
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
        target_label: kubernetes_namespace
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
        target_label: kubernetes_pod_name
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        target_label: app
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_version]
        target_label: version
    
    metric_relabel_configs:
      # Drop high-cardinality labels
      - source_labels: [__name__]
        regex: 'go_.*'
        action: drop
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # PostgreSQL Exporter
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  - job_name: 'postgres'
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - postgres-exporter:9187
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__address__]
        target_label: instance
        replacement: postgres-primary
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Redis Exporter
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  - job_name: 'redis'
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - redis-exporter:9121
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__address__]
        target_label: instance
        replacement: redis-cache
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Node Exporter (Infrastructure)
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  - job_name: 'node'
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: node
    
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__address__]
        regex: '(.*):10250'
        replacement: '${1}:9100'
        target_label: __address__
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_name]
        target_label: node
  
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Kubernetes API Server
  # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  - job_name: 'kubernetes-apiservers'
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: endpoints
    
    scheme: https
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
    bearer_token_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
    
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace, __meta_kubernetes_service_name, __meta_kubernetes_endpoint_port_name]
        action: keep
        regex: default;kubernetes;https
```
